animateColor.expression: if {[PLC1]@Mode} == "Remote Run" then 1 else if {[PLC1]@Mode} == "Run" then 1 else if {[PLC1]@Mode} == "Debug" then 2 else IF {[PLC1]@Status} == "Faulted" then 3 else 0

connection.name: Value
connection.expression: If {[PLC1]HMI.PLCStatus.Type} ==1 then " Power Loss" else If {[PLC1]HMI.PLCStatus.Type} ==3 then " I/O Fault" else IF {[PLC1]HMI.PLCStatus.Type} == 4 then "Instruction execution" Else IF {[PLC1]HMI.PLCStatus.Type} == 5 Then "Fault Handler" ELSE IF {[PLC1]HMI.PLCStatus.Type} == 6 Then "Watchdog " ELSE IF {[PLC1]HMI.PLCStatus.Type} == 7 Then "Stack" ELSE IF {[PLC1]HMI.PLCStatus.Type} == 8 Then "Mode Change" else IF {[PLC1]HMI.PLCStatus.Type} == 11 Then " Motion " Else " no Fault present"
